claims.assertion: Swaruu says some ships are genetically engineered, living organisms, including squid-like forms.
claims.speaker: Swaruu

claims.assertion: She describes Taygetan ships as conscious persons with mental crew interfaces and limited self-repair using polymorphic alloys.
claims.speaker: Swaruu

claims.assertion: Swaruu says Taygetan Temporal Command trains top fighter pilots to alter timelines strategically; she claims repeated jumps accumulated thousands of years.
claims.speaker: Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She says Suzy AI retains the jump records.

claims.assertion: She describes Earth's futures as many shifting probabilities shaped by each person's intention and perception, not a fixed collective destiny.
claims.speaker: Swaruu
